findings.issue: E2E tests in tests/e2e/ depend on test-signin.json credentials file that does not exist in the repository or CI â€” tests will fail with fallback default credentials that won't authenticate
findings.impact: The Core E2E test suite (auth, messaging, navigation, search, file-upload) silently falls back to hardcoded test credentials that don't match any real Supabase project. All dependent tests will fail with authentication errors in CI. The credential file is gitignored with no setup instructions
findings.fix: Create a test-signin.example.json template committed to repo, add CI secret for test credentials, create a setup step that generates test-signin.json from CI secrets before test execution. Alternatively, use Supabase local emulator for CI with seed data

findings.issue: WebSocket real-time E2E test exists but depends on credentials file and may not reliably assert dual-context message delivery â€” lacks disconnect/reconnect and typing indicator coverage
findings.impact: The sole WebSocket test (multi-page message delivery) is fragile because it depends on external auth. No tests cover: socket disconnect/reconnect behavior, typing indicators, presence updates, or optimistic echo deduplication in real time
findings.fix: Make the WebSocket test resilient by adding mock Socket.io fallback for CI. Add E2E scenarios for: disconnect/reconnect banner visibility, typing indicator cross-page visibility, presence indicator updates. Use Socket.io debug logging in test output

findings.file: tests/e2e/ (no existing tests for error states)
findings.issue: No E2E coverage for error states, API failures, permission denials, or offline/degraded mode behavior across any test file
findings.impact: The error state UI (loading skeletons, error messages, try-again buttons) and authorization enforcement (private channels, workspace access, forbidden routes) are never tested. Defects in error handling or authorization would only be discovered in production
findings.fix: Add E2E scenarios using Playwright route interception for: API 500 response shows error message with retry button, unauthorized workspace access shows 403/redirect, private channel without membership shows restricted state, offline mode shows connection banner. Mock specific failure responses

findings.file: apps/web/e2e/ (no performance test), tests/e2e/ (no performance test)
findings.issue: No performance test for channels with 500+ messages â€” virtualization implementation (@tanstack/react-virtual) has no automated validation of scroll performance or memory usage
findings.impact: The MessageList component uses @tanstack/react-virtual for windowed rendering, but the degradation point (max messages before noticeable jank) is unknown. Scroll performance, memory growth, and render time at scale are not validated
findings.fix: Add a performance E2E test that seeds 500+ messages via API route interception, navigates to the channel, measures initial render time, scrolls to bottom, and measures scroll jank. Set performance budget (render < 2s, scroll < 16ms frame time)

findings.issue: No standard test fixtures directory for files, user data, or API mocks across both e2e directories
findings.impact: Each test file defines inline fixtures (MOCK_USER, TEST_EMAIL constants) or references test-signin.json. There is no shared fixture library. Test files reference test data inconsistently. API mock routes are duplicated across spec files in both e2e directories
findings.fix: Create a shared fixtures directory with: test-users.json, test-files/ (1KB test.png, test.pdf, test.mp3), api-mocks.ts (shared route handlers). Remove inline fixture duplication. Consolidate the two e2e directories into a single location

findings.issue: E2E tests (apps/web/e2e/ and tests/e2e/) are not separated into fast smoke vs. slow comprehensive tiers for CI execution
findings.impact: All E2E tests run as a single flat group on every PR. Fast smoke tests (auth form rendering, 404 page) are blocked behind slower comprehensive tests (file upload, search, multi-page messaging). PR feedback loops are longer than necessary
findings.fix: Split E2E tests into 3 CI tiers: smoke (PR gate, ~2min: auth form, navigation, 404 page), critical (merge to develop, ~5min: messaging, file upload), nightly (scheduled, ~15min: comprehensive, real-time, multi-context). Use --grep or sharding in Playwright config
